Sam (CS): Quick follow-up from today's outage: we need a short public status update, a private enterprise note template (SLA + remediation ETA), and a clear policy on how/when to share RCAs with customers. Volunteers?

Eve (SRE): I can own remediation + timeline. Plan: immediate throttle rule rollback (within 24h), full fix (adaptive rate limiting + tests) in 10 business days. Filing INC-4999.

Rakesh (PM): Noting recurrence: similar behavior in Feb. I'll run the retro and create a "recurring-incident" checklist (tests + runbook).

Harper (Comms): Draft for status page (short):
"09:20-09:48 UTC: elevated latency affected some API requests. A mitigation is in place and we're monitoring. Short summary within 24h; full RCA within 5 business days. Affected customers can contact support@redwood.ai."

Olivia (Legal): Policy note: public summary ok. For redacted RCAs we require Security + Legal review if customer requests internal logs/diagrams. We should offer a redacted RCA to affected customers and a bilateral NDA route only if they request extremely detailed operational artifacts.

Sam (CS): Action items (adding to INC-4999):
- Eve: rollback hotfix 2024-11-05 due 2024-11-05
- Eve: durable fix + tests due 2024-11-18
- Harper: publish short status (24h) due 2024-11-05
- Rakesh: retro + recurring-incident doc due 2024-11-08
- Olivia + Security: redaction/NDA flow doc due 2024-11-10

notif-bot: INC-4999 created https://tracker.redwood.ai/INC-4999

Harper (Comms): One editorial ask: avoid SLA jargon on public copy. Put SLA impact in private enterprise note.

Rakesh (PM): Agreed. I'll coordinate with Sales to prepare enterprise note template (SLA math + next steps).

Sam (CS): I'll collect the list of affected customers and attach to the tracker. Will ping AEs for urgent outreach.

Eve (SRE): I'll add a dashboard alert for queue growth > threshold and a 90th percentile latency watch. ETA for alerts: 5 days.

Olivia (Legal): If a customer requests full raw logs, send request to legal@redwood.ai and we'll route via Security + NDA review.

Sam (CS): Thanks team. I'll post the statuspage link here when live. :white_check_mark:
